author: YTSanitizer
description: YouTube share-link cleaner for Red. Strips the ?si= share identifier, retriggers the embed, and can delete the original post.
install_msg:
Thanks for installing YTSanitizer.

Auto-clean is off until you turn it on.
`[p]ytsanitizeset mode auto` starts the listener.
`[p]ytsanitizeset mode manual` leaves it command-only.
`[p]ytsanitizeset delete` toggles deleting the original post.

The bot needs Send Messages and Embed Links. Deleting the original also needs Manage Messages.
short: YouTube ?si= cleaner with auto, manual, and delete toggle
